description:
Request for Quote (RFQ) W51AA1-27-Q-A004 is being conducted in accordance with FAR Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services and will utilize simplified procedures for soliciting competition, evaluation, award documentation and notification that complies with FAR Subpart 12.2. 

 The Army Contracting Command (ACC) APG, Tobyhanna Division intends to award a firm fixed price (FFP) purchase order to provide preventative maintenance, diagnostic inspections, and repairs on approximately thirty-nine (39) 400 Hz cycle converters located at Tobyhanna Army Depot, Tobyhanna PA 18466, in accordance with Attachment I, Performance Work Statement. 

 In accordance with FAR Clause 52.237-1, a single site visit will be conducted at Tobyhanna Army Depot on Monday, December 7, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. 

 This requirement is being solicited as a 100% small business set aside under NAICS 811210 (Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance) and PSC J059 (Maint/Repair /Rebuild of Equipment: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Components). The Small Business Administration (SBA) size standard for NAICS 811210 is $34.0 million (in average annual receipts).
